display.purpose: Hero name and primary hooks only. Maximum three lines at display size.

headline.purpose: Section titles, project names, career timeline entries.

label.purpose: Dock tooltips, metadata, small chip text. Never at body-size with ink-muted.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action button. Electric mint fill, dark ink text, gentle rounded corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #64ffda; color: #111111; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4ecdc4; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button with Electric Mint outline. Fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: 2px solid #64ffda; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #64ffda; color: #111111; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Magnetic CTA Button
components.description: Hero CTA variant. Gradient fill, expanding glow on hover, perspective lift. The portfolio's primary personality statement.
components.css: .ds-btn-magnetic { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #64ffda 0%, #4ecdc4 100%); color: #111111; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: none; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(100,255,218,0.3); transform: perspective(1000px); transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-magnetic::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 0; height: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(100,255,218,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); transition: width 0.6s ease, height 0.6s ease; pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-magnetic:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(100,255,218,0.3); transform: perspective(1000px) translateZ(20px); } .ds-btn-magnetic:hover::before { width: 300px; height: 300px; } .ds-btn-magnetic:active { transform: perspective(1000px) translateZ(10px) scale(0.98); }

components.name: SpotlightCard
components.description: Primary project/content card. Mouse-tracking radial spotlight on hover is the defining interaction.
components.html:
Project Title

Description of the project and the thinking behind it.
components.css: .ds-spotlight-card { position: relative; border-radius: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 2rem; overflow: hidden; --mouse-x: 50%; --mouse-y: 50%; } .ds-spotlight-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 1; background: radial-gradient(circle at var(--mouse-x) var(--mouse-y), rgba(100,255,218,0.1), transparent 80%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.5s ease; pointer-events: none; } .ds-spotlight-card:hover::before { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-spotlight-card > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; } .ds-spotlight-card h3 { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-spotlight-card p { color: #a0a0a0; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 1rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #ffffff; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(160,160,160,0.6); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #64ffda; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(100,255,218,0.15); }

narrative.overview:
This is an interface built at the intersection of precision and exploration. The void-black canvas is not a backdrop — it is the working environment. The electric-mint accent is the signal: alive, responsive, energetic. Every interaction reveals that something is running, thinking, responding beneath the surface.

The system rejects the legible categories: it is not a terminal, not corporate, not the warm-minimal of 2026, and emphatically not the generic neon-teal portfolio template. The difference from template is not in the accent color — it is in how that color behaves.

Tone is calibrated confidence. The portfolio shows depth in AI/ML not by listing tools, but by demonstrating the quality of thinking. The interface itself is evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Void black as active canvas, not passive void
Electric-mint is the sole accent; its rarity and reactivity are the point
All motion is deliberate — every animation reveals state or rewards attention
Depth through interaction, not through layering
Single typeface (Inter) doing all the heavy lifting through weight contrast alone

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Electric Mint is the only accent. No purple gradients, no orange highlights, no secondary brand colors in the dark theme. Every appearance of the accent is intentional.

rules.name: The AAA Correction Rule
rules.body: #a0a0a0 on void-black fails WCAG AAA for normal text. Secondary body text must use #c8c8c8 or lighter.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface. Never introduce a second family.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling
rules.body: Display weight is 800, maximum. The scale works because the jump from 400 to 800 is decisive.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The accent glow appears only in response to interaction.

rules.name: The Monochrome Shadow Rule
rules.body: The only colored shadow in the system is the accent glow. All ambient shadows are rgba(0,0,0,X).

rules.name: The Motion Authenticity Rule
rules.body: The MagnetLines background only exists because it responds. A static version would be decoration. If performance requires removal, remove it entirely.

dos: Do use #64ffda (Electric Mint) exclusively as the interaction accent.
Do apply the accent glow (rgba(100,255,218,0.3)) as the shadow for all accent-colored interactive elements.
Do ensure all body-weight text meets ≥7:1 contrast (WCAG 2.1 AAA).
Do keep button interactions physical: glow, perspective shift, particle response.
Do apply the SpotlightCard mouse-tracking radial gradient to every primary card component.
Do preserve the MagnetLines background on desktop.
Do use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 headings.
Do include prefers-reduced-motion alternatives for every animation.
donts: Don't use a second accent color alongside Electric Mint in the dark theme.
Don't build a dark + neon-teal card grid — the generic AI-developer-portfolio template.
Don't use cream, sand, or warm-neutral backgrounds.
Don't create a corporate-SaaS layout with metric tiles or hero-number templates.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or section markers.
Don't apply gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use #a0a0a0 for normal body text — fails WCAG AA and AAA.
Don't remove the MagnetLines background and replace it with a static pattern.
